ui.title: OFFICE CHAOS
ui.subtitle: 8 coworkers. 1 invisible meddler. Zero rules.
ui.new_game_confirm: Start over? Your current office will be lost.
ui.no_events: Nothing has happened yet. Give it a minute… or give it a nudge.
ui.tap_hint: Tap glowing objects to meddle. Tap people to read their file.
ui.how_to_text:
You are an invisible force haunting a small office.

You can't control anyone. Instead, tap the glowing things — the coffee machine, the printer, computers, the meeting board, the thermostat, the light breaker, the boss's promotion file, people's belongings — and meddle.

Most meddling is sneaky: nothing happens until someone actually uses that thing. Break the printer and wait for someone to need it. Swap an email recipient and wait for them to hit send.

Everyone has a personality, a goal, friendships, rivalries, secrets and a memory. What happens next depends on all of it — and on yesterday.

There are no missions and no score. Help them, ruin them, or just watch.

mem.bd_party: Everyone threw me a surprise birthday party.

log.bg_hide: {culprit} kept their head down. Ahmet is now looking at {scapegoat}.
log.bg_confessed: {culprit} walked into Ahmet's office and admitted the wrong figures were theirs.
log.bg_proof: Ahmet accused {scapegoat} of the wrong figures. {scapegoat} told him to check the file history.
log.bg_injustice: Ahmet blamed {scapegoat} for the wrong figures. {scapegoat} took it — but it was {culprit}.
log.bg_truth: The file history doesn't lie: the figures were {culprit}'s. Ahmet now knows {culprit} let {scapegoat} take the blame.

log.mp_cover: {mentor} told Ahmet the report error was their own fault — to protect {protege}.

log.mp_exploit_fail: {rival} tried to use {mentor}'s cover-up against them. Ahmet wasn't interested.
log.mp_confess: {protege} marched into Ahmet's office and confessed: the error was theirs, {mentor} was protecting them.

mem.mp_bonded: {mentor} protected me when I messed up.

log.pp_dismiss: {climber} asked Ahmet about a promotion and got brushed off.
log.pp_promise: {climber} asked Ahmet about a promotion. He hinted it's theirs.
mem.pp_brushed: Ahmet brushed off my promotion request.

log.pp_grind_solo: {climber} is working like a machine on the Kaya pitch.

log.pp_flop: {climber}'s Kaya pitch fell apart in front of Ahmet.

mem.bc_warning: Ahmet gave me a final warning.
